growth.title: Opportunities & outreach
growth.subtitle: Campaign plans, the opportunity pipeline, controlled outreach, judgment reviews and metrics share one entry point; each section opens as its task flow goes live.
growth.outreachDesc: Outreach is organized in reviewed batches: drafts are approved before anything is sent, send windows and mailbox caps are enforced, and replies stop the sequence; unsubscribe and do-not-contact checks are enforced before every send.
growth.outreachPoint1: Draft approval: preview, edit and approve before anything can be sent
growth.outreachPoint2: Send gates: jurisdiction consent, do-not-contact list and send window checked per message
growth.outreachPoint3: Reply handling: classification and suggested outcome confirmed in one click
growth.outreachNote: No e-mail is sent until the sending channel is enabled.

findBuyers.subtitle: Define your target customer profile and let GainOS discover overseas companies by market and product — with fit, need and reachability judged before delivery.

findBuyers.step2Desc: Industry, countries, size, exclusions and buyer roles — set once, reused for every task.
findBuyers.step3Desc: Starts right after confirmation, typically 20–60 minutes; progress and failures are shown honestly.
findBuyers.listDesc: AI drafts from the approved facts in your company profile; edit freely before activating.
findBuyers.activeHint: Active: {name} (one active target-buyer set per profile)
findBuyers.emptyDesc: Pick a company profile and let GainOS draft one; review the rules and activate before generating a sourcing plan.

findBuyers.factsCheckFailed: Could not confirm this company's facts. Please retry.

findBuyers.approvedFactsCount: {count} approved facts available for designing target customer profiles.

contacts.title: Decision makers
contacts.subtitle: Named contacts are personal data. Unconfirmed or inferred e-mails are not guaranteed; verify before sending.
contacts.emptyDesc: Discovery shows name, title, department and contact points, with source links and evidence timestamps.
contacts.scopeHint: Decision-maker data is gated by the engine’s narrow contact-discovery:read scope, granted to admins only; if the engine image or role mapping is not ready, the card shows “integration not ready” and stays read-only.
contacts.discoverOnceHint: The discovery grant is bound to the company: discovery can succeed only once per company; contact operations to arrange another attempt (repeat attempts are rejected by the one-time grant).
contacts.guessBlocked: {count} verifications were blocked by the compliance gate (no probes sent).
contacts.missingEmail: {count} decision makers still have no e-mail. Use “Guess e-mails” to infer and verify from the company e-mail pattern.
contacts.discoverDesc: The engine looks through the website, registries, trade fairs and social sources for named contacts. This can take several minutes and consumes execution budget.
contacts.guessDesc: Infers e-mail addresses from the company pattern and performs an SMTP handshake for decision makers without one. Inferred results may stay unconfirmed and consume execution budget.
contacts.verifyDesc: Performs one SMTP handshake against {email}; the result is written back to the contact point.
contacts.riskyWarning: This e-mail is unconfirmed or inferred; verification may still not confirm it.
contacts.acknowledge: I understand this e-mail is uncertain and still want to verify it
contacts.noBasis: Discovering or probing named contacts requires an explicit lawful basis; without one the engine refuses before writing any data.

basisHint.legitimate_interest: For B2B outreach: requires a completed LIA; put its reference into “Basis reference”.
basisHint.consent: Only when the person has explicitly consented; cite the consent record.
basisHint.contract: Contact is necessary to perform an existing contract; cite the contract.
basisHint.legal_obligation: Contact or verification is legally required; cite the statute or ticket.

contacts.discoverDone: Discovery finished; {count} decision makers are now available.
contacts.guessDone: E-mail guessing finished: {attempted} attempted, {persisted} stored, {verified} verified.
contacts.verifyBlocked: Verification was blocked by the compliance gate (BLOCKED); no probe was sent.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Your own login, membership, and permission actions in this company. To prevent cross-tenant leakage only your records are shown; platform operations are audited in the ops console.

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.subtitle: Submit GDPR Art.17 erasure / Art.21 objection requests. The engine processes them asynchronously and returns count-only receipts.
privacy.rightAccess: Access & export: delivered leads via the weekly CSV
privacy.rightErasure: Erasure: delete personal data for a company or contact
privacy.rightObjection: Objection: stop processing and add a legal suppression
privacy.rightResponse: Receipts: status and counts, never personal data
privacy.scopeNote: A deletion request first freezes and records a legal suppression, then erases asynchronously; the subject is never re-ingested or contacted.
privacy.formDesc: Provide the engine subject id (company or contact record ID). Requests are processed asynchronously; track status below.
privacy.subjectIdHint: Pick a company from the list; for a contact, paste its engine UUID
privacy.requestRefHint: Ticket / LIA / contract reference (audit only, no personal data)
privacy.asyncNote: Returns 202 with a request id immediately; do not resubmit before it completes.
privacy.submitted: Accepted {id}; refresh later to check status
privacy.invalidId: Subject ID is not a UUID
privacy.invalidIdHint: Copy the UUID from the company or contact details
privacy.noTracked: No deletion requests yet. Request ids live only in this browser, so keep them safe.
privacy.subject: Subject
privacy.unknownStatus: Not found (still processing or not in this company)
privacy.trackedNote: Receipts contain counts only, never personal data. This list currently lives only in this browser (no server-side list yet); clearing it does not affect the server.

metrics.catalogEmptyHint: Metrics appear by tier once the dictionary sync completes.
